why: A press steps a full tenth from wherever a slider drag left the level, so the steppers walk 37, 47, 57 instead of the one grid of tenths (issue #918). On-grid levels step the same either way, which is why only the off-grid cases catch it.
killedBy: the volume steppers: a controller reaches the level (issue #918) steps to the next tenth in its direction, snapping a level between tenths
